paite: Belamnou in chiamtehna sagihte lak a khat aphel lai ka mu a, thil hing lite lak a khat aw in, vanpiging bang mai in, "Hong pai in," achih ka za hi.
heading: Chiamtehna Honna
english: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, “Come and see!”

paite: Huan ka etleh ngai in, sakol kang leh atung a tupa thalpeu tawi ka mu a; amah kiang ah lallukhu piak in a-om a; amah vualzou a vualzou zou zel ding in ahong paikhia hi.
english: And behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he came forth conquering, and to conquer.

paite: Huan chiamtehna nihna aphel lai in, thil hing nihna in, "Hong pai in,” achih ka za hi.
english: When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”

paite: Sakol dang asan khat ahong paikhia a; huai tung a tupa kiang ah leitung a kipan lemna lakhe ding a thupiak ahi a, huchi a amau akithahtuahna ding un; amah kiang a namsau thupi piak ahita hi.
english: Another came forth, a red horse. To him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another. There was given to him a great sword.

paite: Huan chiamtehna thumna aphel lai in thil hing thumna in, "Hong pai in," achih ka za hi. Ka etleh ngai in, sakol vom ka mu hi; atung a tupa'n akhut in bukna atawi hi.
english: When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come and see!” And behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.

paite: Huan thil hing lite lai ah aw hileh kilawm in, "Huit buh tehna dan khat dinari khat, huan barli buh tehna dan thum in dinari khat, huan thau leh uain zaw hihse ke'n," achih ka za hi.
english: I heard a voice in the midst of the four living creatures saying, “A choenix A choenix is a dry volume measure that is a little more than a litre (a little more than a quart). of wheat for a denarius, and three choenix of barley for a denarius! Don’t damage the oil and the wine!”

paite: Chiamtehna lina aphel lai in, thil hing lina aw in, "Hong pai in," achih ka za hi.
english: When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living creature saying, “Come and see!”

paite: Ka etleh ngai in, sakol daang ka mu hi; atung a tupa min Sihna ahi a, Misikhua toh akizui uhi. Namsau, kial leh sihna leh leitung a gam sahangte thah ding in amau kiang ah leitung seh li suah seh khat tung a thuneihna piak ahita hi.
english: And behold, a pale horse, and he who sat on it, his name was Death. Hades or, Hell followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.

paite: Chiamtehna ngana aphel lai in, Pathian thu ziak leh azuih uh theihsakna ziak a amau thah a omte maitam nuai ah ka mu hi.
english: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God, and for the testimony of the Lamb which they had.

paite: Amaute aw ngaihtak a kikou in, "Toupa Tungnungpen aw, siangthou leh dik bang tan ka sisan man uh amau leitung a tengte tung a thuk lou leh vaihawm lou ding na hia?" achi uhi.
english: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?”

paite: Amaute kiang ah puanngou thupi piak in a-om chiat ua; amau asikha hihpihte uleh a-unaute uh amau bang a thah a om dingte akim mateng uh na khawl tadih un chi a hilh in a-om uhi.
english: A long white robe was given to each of them. They were told that they should rest yet for a while, until their fellow servants and their brothers, The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” who would also be killed even as they were, should complete their course.

paite: Chiamtehna gukna aphel lai ka mu a, zinling thupitak a-om hi. Nisa tuh samul sai-ip puan bang in ahong vom a, kha leng apum in sisan bang in asan hi.
english: I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.

paite: Van aksite theipi kung huihpi in amutling a, ahutte apulh bang in leitung ah apulh uhi.
english: The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.

paite: Van laibuzial bang a kizial zou in suanmang in a-omta; tang sangte leh tuikulh gam teng amun ua pat suanmang in a-omta uhi.
english: The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island were moved out of their places.

paite: Huchi in leitung kumpipate, miliante, heutute leh ahat leh ahaute, salte leh sal lou teng leng tang sangte leh suangpi heng leh kokhukte ah akisel uhi.
english: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.

paite: Tang sangte kiang leh suangpite kiang ah, "Hon delhlum unla, amah laltutphah tung a tupa leh Belamnou thangpaihna mai a kipan hon sel un;
english: They told the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,

paite: athangpaihna ni thupi hong tung hi; kua adingh zou dia?” achi uhi.
english: for the great day of his wrath has come; and who is able to stand?”
